purpose: Fail-closed isolated persistence anchored to GitHub-returned blob identity.

first_tool_sequence: update heartbeat IN_PROGRESS using fresh SHA
re-fetch heartbeat and verify current RUN_ID and automation_id
write/re-fetch checkpoint BOOTSTRAPPED before substantive work

closure.pass_8: freeze complete RUN_CORE into checkpoint FROZEN_FOR_FINALIZATION and re-fetch

pass_9_core.rule: Create immutable core/<RUN_ID>.json containing exactly RUN_CORE; re-fetch and record GitHub core blob SHA.

pass_9_history.rule: Create immutable history/<RUN_ID>.json as a DISTINCT METADATA ENVELOPE, never as RUN_CORE content.
pass_9_history.invariant: history_blob_sha MUST differ from run_core_blob_sha. Equality means INVALID_HISTORY_DUPLICATES_CORE and the run MUST be quarantined with no latest/finalization promotion.

pass_10.rule: Write/re-fetch latest.json referencing current core/history blob SHAs. Only when core/history are both valid and history_blob_sha != run_core_blob_sha may finalization/<RUN_ID>.json be created. Finalization must bind current core/history/latest blob SHAs. Then checkpoint FINALIZED and heartbeat IDLE/FINALIZED.

foreign_writer_rule: Any write outside automation/omega-native-v2:automation_intelligence/omega_stack_native_v2/ or by an automation_id not listed in isolated control_plane.active[] is non-authoritative for native-v2.
scheduler_identity_rule: Each lane's live scheduler ID must exactly match control_plane.active[].automation_id. Scheduled lanes may never mutate scheduler topology.

idle_identity_rebind.rule: If heartbeat/checkpoint/latest has RUN_ID null and status IDLE or INITIALIZED, an automation_id mismatch is stale metadata, not an active-run conflict. The current live task may overwrite that mutable file with the control-plane automation_id during bootstrap before assigning a new RUN_ID. Immutable core/history/finalization artifacts are never rewritten.
